features.name: Alien Alteration
features.description:
At 1st level, your bloodline remodeled your form. Choose one:

**Binary Mind.** Enlarged partitioned brain: use Search action or make an INT/WIS check as a bonus action.
**Digitigrade Legs.** Speed +10 ft; stand from prone for 5 ft of movement.
**Grasping Tentacle.** As an action, transform one arm into a tentacle (natural reach weapon, 1d6 + CHA bludgeoning, CHA for attack, grapple at turn start = 1d6 bludgeoning). No fine motor control. Revert as bonus action.
**Prehensile Tail.** Use an Object as bonus action. Can hold material components and perform somatic components. Interact with 2 objects free per turn (1 via tail).

features.name: Aberrant Physiology
features.description: Starting at 1st level, when a creature scores a critical hit on you, use your reaction to shift your vital organs and turn it into a normal hit (cancels all critical hit effects). Uses equal to proficiency bonus; regain all on long rest.

payload.name: Aberrant Physiology
payload.description: When you take a critical hit: turn it into a normal hit (cancels crit effects).

features.name: Advanced Transformation
features.description:
At 6th level, your chosen Alien Alteration evolves (or choose a second Alien Alteration instead):

**Caustic Tentacle (Grasping).** Tentacle secretes acid: +2d6 acid on hit (bonus action to suppress). Grappled creatures take acid damage at start of your turn.
**Cognitive Split (Binary).** When you use your action to cast a spell, use a bonus action to make one melee or ranged weapon attack.
**Fell Sprinter (Digitigrade).** Dash or Disengage as bonus action each turn. When Dashing, extra movement = 2× speed.
**Third Arm (Prehensile Tail).** Tail extends to 15 ft, splits into five fingers. Can wield a weapon with tail; drink potions as bonus action.

features.name: Absorb Arcana
features.description: Starting at 14th level, when you succeed on a save against a spell that would deal damage, use your reaction and spend sorcery points equal to the spell's level to reduce the damage to 0.

payload.name: Absorb Arcana
payload.description: Succeed on a save vs a damaging spell: spend sorcery points equal to spell level to reduce damage to 0.

features.name: Spontaneous Transformation
features.description: At 18th level, as a bonus action, gain a second Alien Alteration option and its Advanced Transformation evolved form for 1 minute. 1/short or long rest.

payload.name: Spontaneous Transformation
payload.description: Gain a second Alien Alteration + Advanced Transformation for 1 minute.
